limitations: ASSUMED parametric simulation candidate; not a released routed antenna design.
Perfect-conductor trace/ground and battery surrogate omit conductor and cell losses.
The TLL-5902 package envelope is represented as a PEC cuboid; battery internals, terminals, tolerances, and combined PCB/enclosure fit have not been validated.
Generic dielectric placeholders are not selected or characterized materials.
The animal case is a homogeneous sensitivity slab, not tissue or anatomy validation.
